description: Take a page out of a Space's list. The page stays published, and the Space keeps its other pages and documents. Use it when the reader asks to drop a page from a Space; spaces_get_space lists the slugs in it. Needs the owner or editor role.

slug.description: A page slug from search_collection or get_note, for example "concepts/teaming/team-topologies".

name: spaces_remove_note
title: Remove a page from a Space
